g.title: Chooses concrete runtime, persistence, auth, host, and presentation layers.
Mount dispatch, path helpers, request services, request logging, metrics, spans, and JSON encoding.
Shared use-case/tool contracts consumed by MCP, assistant, and Agent Auth.

div.p: Rule of thumb: dependencies point inward. Apps choose concrete layers; presentation and adapters translate protocols; actions expose reusable use cases; core owns business behavior. backend-host is shared runtime plumbing, not a Coffee onion layer.

text.tspan: HTTP API, MCP, auth, assistant, discovery, assets
Better Auth + Agent Auth capability adapter
